title: Hearing the Word
definition: Hearing the Word is receiving Scripture as it is read, taught, preached, and applied among God's people.
summary: God's people are called to hear His Word with faith, humility, and obedience.
christFocus: Jesus says His sheep hear His voice and follow Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Hearing the Word is a vital part of Christian life. God works through the public reading, preaching, and teaching of Scripture.

Hearing must be active, not passive. Scripture calls believers to receive the implanted Word with humility and to respond with obedience.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people hear sermons or Scripture readings without truly listening. Hearing the Word matters because faith is strengthened when God's Word is received rightly.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Prepare your heart before hearing Scripture. Listen attentively, take the Word seriously, and respond with faith, repentance, and obedience.
